units.§1: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] When the parameter is redrawn independently at every step it can be integrated out of the dynamics.
units.§2: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Observation 3. Per-step i.i.d. parameters yield an ordinary MDP with averaged transitions and rewards; past observations carry no information about future parameters.
units.§3: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Scope. The statement concerns i.i.d. redraws only; it says nothing about parameters that persist over time.
